We will ALWAYS stand with the brave men and women in blue who keep our communities safe day in and day out.

South Carolina is safer when its officers are respected, resourced, and backed by the people they serve. While Washington plays politics with public safety, we will keep standing with the men and women wearing the badge.

South Carolina STRONG.

President Trump and Secretary Rollins have recognized the importance of revitalizing our domestic seafood industry, just weeks ago establishing a brand new Office of Seafood at USDA. 

One of our amendments to the Farm Bill would codify the new Office of Seafood, ensuring they have a seat at the table going forward and are effectively integrated into USDA programs.

American shrimpers, fishermen, and seafood processors deserve the same federal support as every other American farmer. Our amendmen

Our hearts and prayers are with the family and loved ones of Citadel Cadet Evan Greenleigh, who was killed in a tragic boating accident near Shem Creek this weekend.

Evan was a Mechanical Engineering major, a member of Echo Company, and a tennis player with a bright future ahead of him. He was taken far too soon.

We are praying for his family, his teammates, and everyone at The Citadel mourning his loss.

Luke 20:36

American taxpayer dollars should support American fishermen, not foreign competitors. 

Our amendment to the Farm Bill excludes seafood not harvested, cultivated, and processed within the United States from being purchased with SNAP benefits. This protects domestic producers and ensures federal food assistance dollars stay in American hands.

There is no reason federal dollars should be going to foreign seafood operations overseas, while our shrimpers and fishermen are being undercut.

The Lowcountry's shrimpers, fishermen, and seafood processors are a driving force behind our state and a lifeline for families up and down the South Carolina coast.

We held a press conference with Bryan Jones, Vice President of the South Carolina Shrimpers Association, to talk about our introduction of four amendments to the Farm Bill and cosponsoring of a fifth to deliver long-overdue federal support to South Carolina's commercial shrimping and fishing industries.

America's fishermen are farm

Making America healthy again starts with what is on our plates. Weakening pesticide oversight moves in the wrong direction. 

We've filed an amendment to strip pesticide loopholes from the Farm Bill. 

These provisions preempt state and local authority, shut down judicial review, and hand EPA bureaucrats unchecked power to define what is safe. 

South Carolina farmers, families, and communities deserve better. Our amendment strips them out.

For too long, Washington’s answer to wild horses has been a helicopter and a holding pen, on the taxpayer’s dime.

We filed an amendment to the Farm Bill including key provisions of our Veterans for Mustangs Act, directing the Secretary of Agriculture to implement humane, reversible, non-surgical fertility controls to manage wild horse and burro populations on Forest Service lands, and prioritizing military veterans to carry out the work.

Our amendment brings common sense and accountability bac

When it comes to Iran, we trust President Trump to do what is right for the United States of America.

Video

THIS is exactly why violent rhetoric towards political figures and people in power must be taken seriously and why safety is a top priority for so many of us.

It’s a scary reality.

May God continue to bless President Trump.

Happy Birthday to our amazing First Lady of the United States, Melania Trump!

Last night, Secret Service agents placed themselves between a gunman and the President of the United States. They did not flinch and protected everyone in the room.

To the Left expressing "relief" on social media - relief means nothing without action. Fund DHS. Stop playing politics with the agencies standing between our leaders and those who wish them harm.

God was watching over our President last night. Now it is time for Congress to do its part. 🇺🇸🙏

“I want to live because I want to make this country great... That's why I want to live. But when you’re impactful, they go after you. When you’re not impactful, they leave you alone.”

This man was entrusted to educate children.
